title: VenueMapVersionPublished
description: Published by Events to farol.events with routing key venue-map-version.published, through the outbox (ADR-004), whenever a member with Map.Edit uploads a new version of an event's venue map (US-19, the first and so far only story that publishes it, from MapEvents.versionPublished). Consumed from reports.events-events (API outline §7.4, §7.5): a help request or a report must point at a map version that exists in its event (US-23, US-47). Only the version and the time it was published: the image itself is read with GET /api/v1/events/{eventId}/map-versions/{version}/image (US-21), and the points of the version change on their own afterwards (US-20, PointOfInterestChanged). Versions are numbered per event, start at 1 and only grow, and an older one stays readable for the requests and reports that name it (US-27). eventId is the event; actorUserId is the sub of the member who uploaded it. AMQP properties: message_id = messageId, type = VenueMapVersionPublished, app_id = events, correlation_id = the request's X-Correlation-Id, content_type application/json, persistent.

eventId.description: Every Events event belongs to a Farol event (ADR-003)

mapVersion.description: The number of the new version, the current one of the event

publishedAt.description: When it was uploaded, the same instant as the row's uploaded_at
